_about: Example study: real public registry information only (ClinicalTrials.gov, retrieved Oct 9 2026). All patients and events in this project are synthetic and are not findings about this study or its drug. The UI refers to the drug by class only.
registry_title: A phase 2 study of an anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody in patients with advanced cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (class-only paraphrase of the public registry title)
title_short: Open-label PD-1 immunotherapy study in advanced skin cancer (example)
dosing_summary: IV infusion every 3 weeks in an outpatient clinic; patients are home between doses (demo cohort modeled on the every-3-week group).

protocol_notes.text: Outpatient administration; doses on Day 1, 22 and 43 of each 9-week cycle (±3 days).
Diarrhea/colitis managed by stools per day over baseline (<4, 4-6, >=7); Grade 3 managed as inpatient.
SAEs and adverse events of special interest reported to the sponsor within 24 hours.
Hospitalization (for SAE purposes) means admission or an ER stay longer than 24 hours.
